storylines: GORD: Moore too, on Butterworth's goal. Fine nights for both. But four losses and a tie is still the record, and I'd like to see a little less moral victory and a little more actual victory. CASEY: Next chance is Sunday. The Pylons, home ice, Canlan, eleven-ten in the morning. We haven't seen them yet this season so we're going in blind, but we're at home, we've got a full week to stew on tonight, and I think this group is going to come out with something to prove. GORD: Sunday morning hockey. That'll either shake the rust off or it'll be six-three again and I'll be grumbling before noon. CASEY: Either way, we'll be here to talk about it. That's Ice & Easy — thanks for listening, we'll see you Sunday.
